g.text: Q5 is optional: it only blocks back-feed into VBUS when PD is off (can be a 0 ohm).
990 uF on the OR bus: each ideal diode turns on into it with no soft start.
Plug-in inrush is set by source impedance; check the barrel supply and PD source survive it.
AP_INT divider: INT is a 5 V push-pull output, 12k/20k puts it at 3.0 V for PB1.
